description: QA Only review (ADR-017 D6). Audits the QA evidence a person ran against the confirmed acceptance criteria and judges task completion from it, with no code review, so it needs no diff. No skill is selected: with no changed file none applies (ADR-017 D2), and the deterministic checks and the completion judgment run regardless.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: The task and its confirmed acceptance criteria.

inputs.name: qa-evidence
inputs.description: The QA evidence a person ran. Optional: absence degrades the completion judgment, which is then never COMPLETE.

steps.description: Missing `tasks` stops here (the only required input).
Without QA evidence this runs in a reduced form and records the degradation.
